notes.title: Freedom!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! There's been no updates in a while. I actually made quite a few but then the game files (and ALL the backups) got corrupted... don't ask how I messed up that badly, I still have no idea. I stated this project many moons ago before I got into version control.

Anyway! Sales have dropped but I'm still eager to share this game, I feel it's still my best work. [b]So I'll be making it free![/b]

I would have just done it immediately but apparently you have to give a bit of a warning so here is that warning. I plan to ask Steam to make the game free next week.

Hope to see any wishlister's at the helm of the planet's defence, soon!

-Arman

notes.title: Version 1.10
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=X7xcrjlyZIY;full][/previewyoutube]

We've had some awesome feedback over the last few months. Most notable was players asking for a continued storyline so we finished it in this patch.

[b]Features[/b]

    Credits

[b]Balance[/b]
    Boss immune to bomb power
    Increase Flac Cannon range

    Other minor changes (more cargo drops)

[b]Design/QOL[/b]
    $ on Former upgrades
    Show correct structure names
    Fix reactor upgrade string
    Toggle ship marker
    Lowered transition time
    Make cargo more accessible (separate menu?)
    Change ark to+ show "can/can't purchase" instead of cost
    Skip track feature

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
    Sound settings not saving properly

notes.title: 1.04 released
notes.notes:
The launch has been great! The support has been overwhelming. That said, it wouldn't be a professional release if it didn't include a pointless day-one patch!

Feedback is much appreciated. You can message me via Reddit with bugs, suggestions, or just comments in general. I plan to make a longer story/more bosses in order to up the playtime but until then, thanks for playing and have a great day!
